items.exampleEn: He always boasts about his expensive car.
items.exampleZh: 他總是在炫耀他的名車。
那個尷尬的男孩臉都紅了。

items.exampleEn: Winning the cup was a great triumph for the small team.
items.exampleZh: 贏得獎盃是這支小球隊的一大勝利。

items.exampleEn: The sad movie was emotionally hard to watch.
items.exampleZh: 那部悲傷的電影在情緒上讓人很難看下去。

items.exampleEn: I could feel the warmth of the sun on my face.
items.exampleZh: 我能感覺到臉上陽光的溫暖。

items.exampleEn: It is cruel to laugh at other people's mistakes.
items.exampleZh: 嘲笑別人的錯誤是很殘忍的。

items.exampleEn: People like him because of his charm.
items.exampleZh: 大家喜歡他，是因為他很有魅力。

items.exampleEn: Her delight was clear when she opened the letter.
items.exampleZh: 她打開信時，高興全寫在臉上。

items.audioEn: My little brother was so embarrassed when he called his teacher "Mom" in class.
items.audioZh: 我弟弟在課堂上把老師叫成「媽媽」，覺得好尷尬。
options: His mom came to his class.
He forgot his homework at home again.
He used the wrong name for his teacher.

items.sentenceEn: Her smile was full of warmth.
She felt emotionally closer to her sister after the trip.
items.sentenceZh: 那趟旅行後，她在情感上和姊姊更親近了。

items.stemEn: The ____ winter killed many of the young trees.
items.stemZh: 殘酷的冬天凍死了很多小樹。

items.stemEn: The city's old buildings and quiet streets give it a special ____.
items.stemZh: 這座城市的老建築和安靜的街道讓它有一種特別的魅力。

items.passageEn: Our class put on a play last month. The story took place in an imaginary land. I played a cruel queen, but in real life I'm shy, so at first I felt embarrassed on stage. One classmate, Tom, kept boasting that he was the best actor. During the play, Tom forgot his lines, and everyone laughed. I helped him by saying his lines for him. After the show, the audience cheered with delight. Our teacher said the play was a triumph. Tom thanked me with real warmth, and I learned that his boasting came from feeling nervous. The play had a simple charm that everyone loved. At the end, I felt emotionally tired but happy.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們班演了一齣戲。故事發生在一片想像中的土地上。我演一個殘忍的皇后，但現實中我很害羞，所以一開始在台上覺得很尷尬。同學 Tom 一直吹噓自己是最好的演員。演出時，Tom 忘了台詞，大家都笑了。我替他說出台詞幫了他。演出結束後，觀眾開心地歡呼。老師說這齣戲大獲成功。Tom 真心熱情地向我道謝，我也明白了他的吹噓其實是因為緊張。這齣戲有一種樸實的魅力，大家都很喜歡。最後，我情緒上很疲累，但很開心。

questions.questionZh: Tom 演出時發生了什麼事？

options: Tom 的吹噓其實是因為緊張

items.promptZh: 令我高興的是，我考試通過了。
referenceEn: To my delight, I passed the exam.
To my delight, I passed the test.
rubricZh: delight 表示「高興」，例如 to my delight 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 embarrassed 造一個句子，說說一次讓你覺得尷尬的經驗。
referenceEn: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang in class.
I was embarrassed because I sang the wrong song.
rubricZh: embarrassed 表示「尷尬的」，例如 feel embarrassed 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
